evidence.title: Footers Blocks for React — Live Previews & Source

name: Spectrum UI Footers
summary: Eighteen interactive footer sections for React from Spectrum UI's open-source block library, with live previews and source.
description: The footers page of Spectrum UI's block library: 18 ready-made footer sections with live previews and source, from an enterprise mega-sitemap and a service-status/uptime footer to newsletter and waitlist capture, a link-search footer, a logo wall and a spotlit wordmark. Every block is free and open source and dogfoods Spectrum UI's own components.
